queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'KeePass Password Safe %' AND publisher = 'Dominik Reichl';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'KeePass Password Safe %' AND publisher = 'Dominik Reichl' AND version_compare(version, '2.61.1') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'keepass.exe');
